programme.raw_outcome_cell:
Թեմայի նպատակին հասնելու համար սովորողը պետք է կարողանա՝
1.Պարտադիր
ներկայացնել «մեխանիկական աշխատանք»,  «հզորություն», մեծությունների ֆիզիկական իմաստը, հաշվարկման բանաձևը, չափման միավորները 
(Հ4)
բացատրել պարզ մեխանիզմների (լծակ, անշարժ և շարժական ճախարակներ, թեք հարթություն) կառուցվածքը և աշխատանքի սկզբունքը,(Հ8, Հ10)
սահմանել լծակի կանոնը, գրել նրա հավասարակշռության պայմանը,(Հ9, Հ10)
հաշվարկել պարզ մեխանիզմների օգտակար գործողության գործակիցը (Հ7, Հ30)
Լրացուցիչ
1) ներկայացնել ձիաուժը՝ որպես հզորության չափման միավոր,
2) բերել կենցաղում և տեխնիկայում, կենդանի օրգանիզմների հենաշարժողական համակարգում պարզ մեխանիզմների օգտագործման օրինակներ:

outcomes.statement_hy:
ներկայացնել «մեխանիկական աշխատանք»,  «հզորություն», մեծությունների ֆիզիկական իմաստը, հաշվարկման բանաձևը, չափման միավորները 
(Հ4)
բացատրել պարզ մեխանիզմների (լծակ, անշարժ և շարժական ճախարակներ, թեք հարթություն) կառուցվածքը և աշխատանքի սկզբունքը,(Հ8, Հ10)
սահմանել լծակի կանոնը, գրել նրա հավասարակշռության պայմանը,(Հ9, Հ10)
հաշվարկել պարզ մեխանիզմների օգտակար գործողության գործակիցը (Հ7, Հ30)
1) ներկայացնել ձիաուժը՝ որպես հզորության չափման միավոր,
2) բերել կենցաղում և տեխնիկայում, կենդանի օրգանիզմների հենաշարժողական համակարգում պարզ մեխանիզմների օգտագործման օրինակներ:

skills.budget_rationale: Work/no-work with a named force and motion; the meaning of one joule.
Direct/inverse A=Fs, comparisons and lifting; integration with previously taught units and speed.
Meaning of watt, A/t, comparison with both variables changing, work-time graph, and taught N=Fv.
Support, force/application line, perpendicular arm and how position affects required force.
F1l1=F2l2, inverse relationships, unknown arm/force and interpretation of measured balances.
Fixed versus moving axle, direction change, ideal force ratio and corresponding rope travel.
Same-height ramp comparisons, force-distance trade-off and ideal work balance.
Useful versus total work, ratio/percent, inverse calculations and measured incline efficiency.
Small optional unit-recognition strand; no memorized conversion or new assessment gate.
Optional familiar applications in household/technology and a supplied musculoskeletal model.

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Distinguish pushing a stationary cabinet from moving a body along a stated force.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Name the force and body; effort or fatigue alone is not mechanical work.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Interpret the force-distance meaning of 1 J.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Unit recall alone overlaps U01-S06; record intentional practice variants separately.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Compare two force-distance products, including inverse reasoning for equal work.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Constant force in the direction of motion; changed numbers are not new reasoning.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Որքա՞ն աշխատանք է պետք բեռը բարձրացնելու համար
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Combine a supplied mass, g and vertical rise for uniform lifting.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Name the lifting force; no signed gravity-work or energy-theorem prerequisite.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Compare power, then distinguish equal power from equal total work.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Specify the work/time interval; a nameplate maximum does not state actual output.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Read a supplied straight work-time graph and calculate A/t.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Source graph is practice-exposed; compare U03 graph/proportional reasoning and retain the work claim.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Identify the support and the two forces in a clearly labelled lever.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Attach the diagram; identifying a tool by appearance alone does not explain its mechanism.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Choose the perpendicular distance from support to line of action.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Use right-angle geometry from the source; no trigonometry or inferred diagram scale.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Compare force-arm products and decide a balance condition.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: State opposing turning effects and a balanced/negligible lever weight; force equality alone is insufficient.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Փորձի գրառումներն ի՞նչ են ցույց տալիս
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Check a table from several measured lever balances.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Instrument tolerance and actual observations matter; answering cannot certify doing the experiment.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Ո՞ր ճախարակն է շարժվում բեռի հետ
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Distinguish the two pulley arrangements and explain their use.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Include a complete rope path and attachment points; do not infer advantage from wheel count.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Link a single movable pulley to half the load force and twice the rope travel.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: State negligible friction, rope/pulley weight, two parallel supporting segments and uniform lifting; no general compound-pulley formula.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Compare ideal ramps reaching the same height.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Keep load and height the same; pull parallel to the plane and neglect friction explicitly.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Ուժի մեջ շահելը աշխատանքի մեջ շահե՞լ է
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Evaluate a claim that a simple machine reduces both input force and input distance for the same useful task.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Exact force-distance reciprocity belongs to the ideal model; real losses do not create useful work.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Identify useful lifting work and total pulling work before calculating efficiency.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Use vertical rise for mgh and travel along the pull for Fl; distinguish fraction from percentage.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Audit supplied incline measurements and identify a specified recording/calculation error.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Do not force real measurements to an expected answer; finite precision and multiple possible errors need explicit data.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Identify horsepower as a power unit from the official additional outcome.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Programme-backed; the printed chapter does not give a horsepower conversion. Do not invent one.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Correct a statement confusing a power unit with a force or work unit.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Intentional practice reinforcement of C01, not a second independent reasoning claim; omit if unhelpful.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Locate support and applied forces in a supplied scissors or balance illustration.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Explain mechanism, not only name the object; screen against S04/S05 and U04-S01.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Interpret a supplied arm model with joint, muscle force and load already labelled.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: No untaught anatomy, muscle-force calculation or mandatory pass condition; use textbook terminology and a complete image.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed candidate brief; not a drafted, approved or qualified question
